name: Album of Daoist and Buddhist Themes: Kings of Hells: Leaf 29
summary: This leaf belongs to the album’s second series of narratives, Ten Kings of Hells. It demonstrates a Chinese-Buddhist approach in which the netherworld is divided into ten realms, each ruled by one of these kings.
